# @mission-platform/email-renderer

Framework-agnostic email, Markdown, and browser renderer for Forge component trees.

## Installation

Add it to a consuming workspace member:

```json
{
  "dependencies": {
    "@mission-platform/email-renderer": "workspace:*"
  }
}
```

## Usage

```ts
import { renderEmail, renderMarkdown } from '@mission-platform/email-renderer';

const html = renderEmail(renderMarkdown('# Hello').node, { title: 'Hello' });
```

Browser previews use the optional adapter entry points, or the aggregate
`@mission-platform/email-renderer/adapters` entry, with the same Forge tree.
